newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end higher,correct losses.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end higher,correct losses.

text.p: Dec 17 - U.S. stock index futures ended higher, correcting earlier losses. Traders said the market turned oversold after dipping to 723.00 at the opening. The slight rebound in U.S. bond prices, and relief following the FOMC meeting, spurred prices higher. However, buying was spotty. Total S&P futures volume was estimated at 88,000 contracts.
